items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Benchmark indices faced a volatile session due to profit booking and investor caution before US inflation data. Analysts indicated that the index needs to create higher highs and lows to signal a potential recovery. While India VIX rose, the Nasdaq ended lower following disappointing inflation data that raised interest rate concerns. Foreign institutional investors net sold shares, while domestic institutions were net buyers on Wednesday.

items.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Jio Financial, Tata Tech, HDB Financial and Wipro
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks ended lower after a volatile session influenced by strong wholesale inflation and elevated crude oil prices. The Nifty 50 declined, testing the support zone of 22,580-22,620, which might weaken with repeated tests. Several companies, such as Reliance Industries and Tata Technologies, are expected to be in focus due to upcoming quarterly earnings.

items.title: Insurance, NPS equity investments plunge 45% to Rs 22,714 crore in September quarter
items.description: Insurance companies and NPS funds have decreased their combined investments in Indian equities by 45%. They invested ₹22,714 crore in the September quarter, compared to ₹41,465 crore prior. Higher bond yields and declining stock prices have shifted their focus towards debt instruments. Mutual funds, on the other hand, continue to invest heavily in equities this quarter.

items.title: Sebi confirms interim curbs on Rajesh Exports, promoter over alleged fund routing
items.description: Sebi has imposed interim restrictions on Rajesh Exports and its promoter Rajesh Mehta for alleged financial misrepresentation. The regulator found issues regarding the reported consolidated revenue of ₹15.4 lakh crore. Rajesh Exports' standalone revenue reported by its subsidiary Valcambi SA was significantly lower at ₹3,027.3 crore. Despite opportunities to respond, the company and promoter failed to adequately rebut Sebi’s preliminary findings.

items.title: Fairfax's IDBI deal premium justified by strategic fit, scale: Analysts
items.description: Analysts believe this acquisition holds considerable potential, greatly enhancing Fairfax's branch network and deposit portfolio in India, paving the way for a diversified financial ecosystem.

items.title: Fairfax offers plan to resolve IDBI-CSB ownership overlapping
items.description: A merger of the two lenders is emerging as the most likely option, potentially allowing the Canadian investor to consolidate its banking interests under a single licence, sources said.

items.title: BHEL shares fall 4% despite Q2 profit jumping 119% YoY. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: BHEL shares fell 4.3% after rallying on strong Q2FY27 results, even as Nuvama and JM Financial retained their Buy ratings and raised target prices. Brokerages cited margin expansion, improved execution, a healthy order book and favourable thermal power prospects.

items.title: 8 Nifty stocks delivered negative returns over 5 years. Do you own any?
items.description: The Indian stock market has seen a sharp upturn but an equally sharp downturn over the past five years, pushing many of India’s most trusted bluechip stocks sharply lower as Trump’s tariff flipflops, Middle East war, falling rupee, surging bond yields and sharp FII outflows weighed. Here are 8 Nifty 50 stocks that have delivered negative returns over the past five years.

items.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex rallies over 1,000 pts, Nifty above 22,900. 4 major factors behind the surge
items.description: Benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex experienced a rebound on Thursday following the previous day's decline. Strong performances by IT and banking stocks contributed to positive sentiment on Dalal Street. Volatility increased as the India VIX rose over 1%, reflecting market fluctuations. Oil prices also fell as investors reacted to geopolitical tensions and easing sanctions on vessels.

items.title: Largecaps are shrinking, smallcaps are getting bigger: What is changing in India’s stock market?
items.description: The Indian stock market is witnessing a notable transformation as large-cap stocks are losing ground amidst changing capital flows and investor sentiment. Mid- and small-cap companies are surging ahead, capturing more market capitalization as domestic institutional investors pivot towards these segments. As large-caps endure foreign selling pressures, the contrast in performance underscores a shift in market dynamics. Future outcomes will hinge on whether earnings growth aligns with current valuations.

items.title: Beware! Blind investing in smallcaps won’t make you money as 148 of 250 stocks tumble in 2026
items.description: More than half of the Nifty 250 stocks have delivered negative returns in 2026 despite the index gaining over 7%. Experts flag elevated valuations and persistent FII selling, stressing selective stock picking as earnings growth and performance diverge across market segments.

items.title: Tata Tech shares rally 8% after Q2 results, but Goldman Sachs and JM Financial stay bearish. Here's why
items.description: Tata Technologies shares surged after reporting a 4% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 171 crore. Revenue grew 28% to Rs 1,699 crore, led by a 34% jump in services revenue to Rs 1,356 crore. EBITDA rose 32% to Rs 273 crore, with margins expanding 40 bps to 16.1%. Services revenue grew 4.3% sequentially in constant currency terms to $142 million.

items.title: LIC Housing Finance among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of October 14, four stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded an increase of more than 7% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session, according to StockEdge F&O scan data. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This may reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing their existing positions.

items.title: Bonfiglioli Transmissions IPO opens for subscription; GMP at 30%: Should you subscribe?
items.description: Bonfiglioli Transmissions IPO opened for subscription on October 15, 2026, aiming to raise Rs 2,533.66 crore via an offer for sale. The price band is set at Rs 558-586 per share with a 30% grey market premium. Anand Rathi has recommended a "Subscribe for Long Term" rating.

items.title: Rainbow Children's Medicare among 4 stocks that closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On October 14, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 1.5% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Vedanta Power among 6 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On October 14, six stocks from the Nifty500 pack that gained over 5% appeared in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.The scan identifies stocks whose RSI values have crossed above 50 from below, indicating strengthening momentum. The Relative Strength Index is a technical indicator commonly used by traders to assess price momentum and trend strength.

items.title: Paytm shares get new Buy rating after Nomura initiates coverage. 3 reasons behind bullish call
items.description: Nomura has initiated coverage on Paytm with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 2,250, implying an upside of 31%. The brokerage expects EBITDA to grow at a 96% CAGR over FY26-29F, driven by payments, merchant lending, AI-led cost efficiencies and potential UPI MDR revenue. International expansion and enterprise AI product Pi offer additional growth opportunities.

items.title: Reliance Industries shares in focus as Jio IPO sets price band for possibly biggest-ever issue. What shareholders must know
items.description: Reliance Industries shares will be in focus after Jio Platforms announced its IPO price band of Rs 1,065-1,119 per share. The Rs 30,213 crore issue includes a shareholder reservation for eligible RIL investors and could become India's largest IPO.

items.title: JSW Energy among 4 stocks showing White Marubozu pattern
items.description: On October 14, four Nifty500 stocks appeared on StockEdge’s White Marubozu bullish scanner.A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in which the opening price is the lowest and the closing price is the highest for the period. It is represented by a long white or green candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow, reflecting strong upward price momentum during the session.

items.title: 950% rally in 6 months! Last day to buy this multibagger microcap stock before reverse stock split. What this mean for investors?
items.description: As the name suggests, it is exactly the opposite of what a stock split does. While a stock split divides shares into multiple shares, a reverse stock split consolidates multiple shares into fewer shares.

items.title: Hyundai Motor to invest $15.5 billion in India by 2032
items.description: Hyundai Motor Group announced plans to invest $15.5 billion in India from 2023 to 2032. This investment aims to enhance manufacturing operations and support growth in the automotive sector. The group recognizes India's importance as a strategic market for future mobility. As part of the investment, Hyundai will also focus on research and development activities and infrastructure enhancement.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 6 midcap stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the NSE midcap pack, six stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 14, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.
